title: Removes iterations parameter for subscription schedules
reason: Not mapped: the adapter names POST /v1/invoices/create_preview `invoices.createPreview.create` from its URL (stripe-operations.ts stripeContractOperations, stripe-benchmark.ts stripeOperations), but stripe-node calls it `invoices.createPreview`, so the call is not traced and no finding names it. (Under fullDiff, oasdiff can still report the operation's change when another mapped call returns the same object, which stops the whole run without naming this call.)

parts.reason: Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.
